title: Apex Industrial Services acquires majority stake in Advanced Technical Solutions
summary: Expanding pipeline integrity and robotics capabilities

contentHtml:
Apex Industrial Services has acquired a majority stake in Advanced Technical Solutions. Image courtesy: Apex Industrial Services

Expanding pipeline integrity and robotics capabilities

Press Release

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — Apex Industrial Services, a portfolio company wholly owned by ECG Industrial Services Fund, has acquired a majority stake in Advanced Technical Solutions (ATS), a Saudi provider of advanced pipeline inspection and integrity services, the companies said Monday.

The deal adds ATS's inspection and asset integrity technology to Apex's growing industrial services platform, which is being built through the consolidation of Saudi-owned and Saudi-based small and mid-sized enterprises (SMEs) into a single holding company ahead of a planned listing on the Tadawul stock exchange. The strategy pairs best-in-class local industrial services operators with state-of-the-art international niche technologies, including robotics, artificial intelligence and drone-based inspection systems.

ECG Industrial Services Fund invests in Saudi industrial and energy-services businesses in line with the objectives of Vision 2030, with a focus on local content, technology transfer and Saudization.

About ATS

ATS specializes in advanced pipeline inspection and integrity solutions, including In-Line Inspection (ILI), UT/UTCD/MFL/EDC technologies, pipeline cleaning and gauging, robotic tank inspection, non-metallic pipeline inspection, leak detection, and specialized non-destructive testing (NDT) solutions. The company works with a network of key technology partners, including NDT Global, FTI, i2i, Tracerco, and EMPIT, among other specialized technology providers.

ATS's project portfolio includes Saudi Aramco emergency pipeline inspection projects, strategic pipeline inspection initiatives, and robotic tank inspection and technology qualification pilot programs. Its client base includes Saudi Aramco, YASREF, Ma'aden, Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), SATORP, and KJO, among other major industrial clients across Saudi Arabia.

Leadership Commentary

Ali Alturki, Founder and Managing Partner, ECG:

“This transaction reflects ECG's core strategy: consolidating outstanding Saudi industrial SMEs into a major national platform, in line with Vision 2030's priorities of local content, technology transfer and Saudization. ATS brings differentiated inspection technology and deep client relationships that strengthen Apex's positioning.”

Paul Sansom, CEO, Apex Industrial Services:

“ATS is a natural fit for Apex. It combines proven, best-in-class inspection and integrity capabilities with an advanced technology roadmap spanning robotics, AI and drone-based solutions — exactly the kind of international niche technology we want at the core of our platform.”

Ayman Altubaji, Chairman, ATS:

“ATS is focused on bringing advanced and differentiated inspection technologies to the Saudi market, supporting our clients in improving asset integrity, safety and operational reliability.”

About Apex Industrial Services

Serving Saudi Arabia's industrial sector since 1977, Apex Industrial Services is a portfolio company wholly owned by ECG Industrial Services Fund. Apex brings together specialist businesses spanning energy, inspection, measurement and control, fire and safety, and resources under one integrated platform, delivering lifecycle industrial solutions to clients across oil & gas, petrochemical, power & water, and metals & mining sectors in the Kingdom and beyond. Apex consolidates a group of Saudi-owned and Saudi-based industrial services SMEs into a single holding company ahead of a planned listing on Tadawul.

About ECG Industrial Services Fund

ECG Industrial Services Fund (ECG) is a specialized private equity platform investing in the energy, industrial, and resource-based sectors. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, ECG builds and scales solutions-oriented businesses that strengthen critical supply chains and support long-term industrial growth, creating sustainable value through operational improvements, localization, and strategic partnerships, with an emphasis on building local content, transferring technology and advancing Saudization.
